title: 豆包手机会泯然众人吗？
content: Nubia’s second-generation Doubao smartphone, slated for release this September, transitions from a direct GUI-operating agent to a hybrid system relying on MCP and A2A protocols. This strategic shift facilitates mass production by aligning with industry standards and reducing dependency on unstable screen scraping. However, it limits functionality to apps that open official APIs. Consequently, the device faces intense competition as competitors adopt similar protocols. Its success now depends on demonstrating superior task management, memory capabilities, and reliable end-to-end execution, distinguishing it from generic AI-powered flagships.
